curiosities: It was sold as a kit for £49.95 or ready-built for £69.95.
Its 16 KB RAM pack was known for wobbling in its socket and crashing the computer.
In FAST mode the screen goes blank while the computer is working.
In the US it was sold as the Timex Sinclair 1000.
Its processor is a Z80A at 3.25 MHz.
It has no sound and shows only black and white.
3D Monster Maze of 1982 is one of the first 3D games on a home computer.
